title: LADA Y vs Teamy McTeamface, Nov 23
notes: Snoqualmie A, the usual camera. We wore light blue as visitors, bench on the right; nets by the rule, the opening faceoffs and the creases, all agreeing. Teamy McTeamface wore white with light blue shoulders, sleeves and socks, which passes our colour test: their #17, #19, #22, #24, #27, #77 and #94 were read hundreds of times and left out.

Played (the sheet's 11 skaters and Hilfer #31 in goal): Kondratenko #12, Ber #14, Yafunyaev #29, Lisitsyn #32, Akulov #37, Unuchek #49, Lisitsyn #70, Podkorytov #82, Lisitsyn #83, Olyanich #89, Barkov #97. Absent: Sokolov #4, Belousenko #11, Belousenko #13, Petrov #18, Fisenko #58, Beregovoy #67 and #87, Mischenko #72, Bronnikov #74, Shakhov #78. No subs. The 298 reads of "4" were Ber's 14.

Periods from the board's clock (all three ran out; the board was dark for 13 of the last 21 s of the 3rd, so that edge is an estimate, checked on the board at 62:26). The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd (their minor 3:00 on the board) and stopped at whistles in the 3rd.

Goal times from the goal checkers, scorers from the sheet: Akulov #37 at P1 9:04, unassisted, off a loose puck in the neutral zone; Lisitsyn #70 at P3 2:14 from Yafunyaev #29, an end-to-end carry. Neither puck was seen inside the net. Their goal at P2 7:59: the sheet credits #6 Kavalec from #94; on video the player who carried it in and jammed it at the post wears #24, read several times, and no #6 was seen on the ice. The sheet stands; the note names its scorer.

Penalties: theirs, #19 Zejdlik hooking Olyanich at P2 6:10, 3:00 on the board though the sheet says 2, no goal on our power play. Ours, Lisitsyn #70 tripping their goalie beside his net at P3 9:10, 2:00, killed off (kill 50:27-52:58 of the video, the whistle to his climbing out of the box).

The lineup was checked by eye at every window the solver flagged, in two rounds: 90 on/off spans (51 in the 1st, 23 in the 2nd, 16 in the 3rd), most for players seated on our bench whom the tracker had on the ice, and for pieces that swapped between players at the bench door. Barkov #97's 5:04 shift in the 2nd (30:46-35:50) is real: two checkers followed him on the ice through it, never seated. Akulov #37's 5:17 shift in the 1st was two shifts with a sit between them. None was set by hand.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 9:04: Akulov #37 picks up a loose puck in the neutral zone, carries it in alone down the middle and beats the goalie from in close at the right post, 1-0
2nd period, clock 7:59: Teamy McTeamface's #6 Kavalec from #94 Slevinsky, carries it in off the far boards past our defense and jams it in at our left post, our goalie going down, 1-1
3rd period, clock 2:14: Lisitsyn #70 from Yafunyaev #29, takes the outlet in our zone, carries it up ice and shoots from the far-side circle past Ber #14's screen, 2-1

2nd period, clock 6:10: Teamy McTeamface's #19 Zejdlik, hooking Olyanich (#89) from behind as he carried the puck through the neutral zone, 3 minutes on the board (the sheet says 2), our power play, no goal
3rd period, clock 9:10: tripping their goalie beside his net as they went for the puck, 2 minutes, killed off
